questions.question: How long does a station last on batteries when it measures every ten minutes?
questions.reference: About 14 months on two 18650 cells (accelerated simulation).
questions.answer:
I couldn't find a battery-life figure for a station measuring every ten minutes in Flux. Ada, you asked in the Czujniki space on 12 June whether anyone had measured the battery sleep current, and I found no answer to that or to the similar questions asked since. Without that number, a lifetime estimate isn't possible.

Flux does show that the reporting interval has changed across firmware versions (5, 6, 8, 10 and 24 minutes), so the 10-minute figure may not match every unit. Battery alarms also keep coming up, such as Gdynia at 2% on 28 October. To get an estimate, someone would need to measure the sleep current and the average current during a measurement, then divide the battery capacity by that average.
